text:
Tara (PTL): PR #8421 is blocked until we attach the design spec + compatibility matrix. This changes routing/shard affinity so we need architecture eyes before merge.

Sam: https://github.com/redwood-infer/redwood/pull/8421 — adding the link here. I'll attach the RFC in a minute.

Lee: quick Q — is this purely runtime routing or are we changing client contracts too?

Tara (PTL): runtime routing only, no client contract changes. Concern is KV-cache locality and potential latency regressions if affinity table misses spike. Need a short canary+fallback plan in the RFC.

Jordan: I can do a design pass today after lunch, but please add the RFC link + a 2-line summary in the PR description.

arch-bot: Automated check: PRs that modify routing/core must include an RFC link and a compatibility checklist. See https://intranet.redwood/rfcs/template — blocking merge until satisfied.

Sam: Updated PR description and added RFC: https://intranet.redwood/rfcs/2026-routing-affinity (also pasted a one-paragraph summary).

Tara (PTL): Can you paste a 2-line TL;DR here for quick async review? helps unblock people who don't want to open the RFC right away.

Sam: TL;DR — add shard-affinity selector to bias requests to the same serving shard to reduce KV-cache misses. Fallback: round-robin when affinity metadata is stale/missing. Canary: 48h @ 10% traffic, monitor token-latency and 5xx rate.

Lee: What's the rollback procedure if we see latency regressions?

Sam: Rollback steps (will add runbook to PR):
```
1) Toggle feature flag to force round-robin routing
2) Disable affinity table updates (reduces churn)
3) If needed, revert the routing service deploy and scale down the affinity worker
```
Will attach dashboards and a simple runbook in the PR in the next hour.

Jordan: Design looks reasonable from my side. Please add the dashboard screenshots for the canary metrics and a short step-by-step runbook in the PR. After that I can give final LGTM on the code.

Tara (PTL): Thanks — holding merge until Jordan's final comment. Target merge window: Tue 09:00 UTC if no regressions. :thumbsup:

Sam: Acknowledged — adding dashboards + runbook now, will ping here when done.
